posts.cooked: Just a quick one here - my Vengeance just arrived and I skimmed through some of the cards while I was sorting them out. One of them is the erm...engine thingys from the MDP environment. This card did come up when I played Vengeance games before but there is just one thing I want to check - it says that if it is "reduced to zero or fewer hp", game over, everyone dies. I just want to check whether Game Over still occurs if you insta-kill it with something (eg Grappling Hook, Sarabande). I have a feeling it doesn't, because you're not reducing its hp but removing it from play entirely (well, into the trash, at least), but I just want to confirm for when it inevitably comes up in a game at some point ;).
